item.title: Famed ocean liner sunk to become world’s biggest artificial reef
item.description: Famed ocean liner SS United States, the largest passenger ship ever built in America and the world’s fastest, headed for the sea floor near Florida on Wednesday in a deliberate sinking designed to transform the vessel into the world’s biggest artificial reef. item.title: What Southeast Asian newsrooms struggling to attract Gen Z can learn from creators
item.description: For Malaysian content creator Iqbal Fatkhi, making news content credible to younger audiences sometimes means making it less like traditional journalism. Instead of polished broadcasts using formal language, the 33-year-old editor-in-chief of news portal CiliSos Media prefers conversational videos that speak to audiences on their own terms. “It’s ironic in a way that, to gain credibility, you have to look not credible in that sense,” he said. His approach reflects a broader shift in news...

item.title: Taiwan to send Acer founder Stan Shih to Shenzhen Apec, calls for ‘equal footing’
item.description: Taiwan will send Stan Shih, founder of computer giant Acer, to the Apec leaders’ summit in Shenzhen next week and has urged Beijing to ensure its delegation is treated with “dignity”. Taiwan has been a member economy of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum under the name “Chinese Taipei” since 1991. item.title: Malaysian police shoot dead machete-wielding man who severed officer’s hand
item.description: A foreign man who allegedly hacked off a Malaysian policeman’s right hand during an attack at an apartment in Desa Amanpuri, Kepong, was shot dead. Armed with two machetes, the suspect charged out of a residential unit and attacked police officers, firefighters and health ministry staff at about 7pm on Wednesday. item.title: Chinese women believe they are long-lost twins after chance sighting in short video
item.description: A chance discovery on a short-video-sharing platform reunited two Chinese women who believe they are twins separated at birth 20 years ago. Recently, 20-year-old Shenzhen resident Luo posted a video documenting her reunion with a woman she believed to be her identical twin sister, a sibling she never knew she had.
